name: Giant Guardians
source:
The human protagonist will go to a land composed by various kingdoms facing each other that are defended by beautiful giant women called "Guardians".

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/giantguardians]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
人类主角将前往一片由多个彼此对峙的王国组成的土地。守护这些王国的，是被称作“守护者”的美丽巨人女性。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/giantguardians]Patreon[/url]]
